levels.surface: أيوب بن عبد الرحمن بن صعصعة الأنصاري

notes: «- وهذا لفظ أبي عامر -» is an editor gloss on the wording, left out; Abu Dawud and Abu Amir are co-transmitters of one level
«أبو داود» is written by the text as a transmitter; it is read as the name in the text and not identified with the compiler (rule 9, rule 13)
«قال أبو داود قال هارون العدوية» is a compiler's wording remark, not a route, left out
Umm al-Mundhir speaks the saying, so she is the last link
